chapter.li: LEChapter30 Verse1 Ammon’s people had been settled in the land of Jershon, and the Lamanites had been driven out of the land and their dead had been buried by the residents. VerseEnd Verse11 The law provided that people were only punished for their crimes, but not for their beliefs. Everyone was equally punished and equally free to believe as they wished. VerseEnd
